description: Admin panel - Complete portfolio management system with authentication, CRUD operations, image upload, project reordering, and publish/unpublish functionality.
steps: Create packages/frontend/src/app/admin/login/page.tsx - Admin login page: centered card with email/password form, 1PLUS branding, error display, redirects to /admin/dashboard on success. Clean, minimal design consistent with main site theme

Create packages/frontend/src/app/admin/layout.tsx - Admin layout: sidebar navigation (Dashboard, Projects, Add New, Settings), header with user info and logout button, main content area. Protected by auth check - redirects to login if no valid token
Create packages/frontend/src/app/admin/dashboard/page.tsx - Admin dashboard: project count stats, recent projects list, quick actions (Add New Project button). Simple overview cards

Create packages/frontend/src/app/admin/projects/page.tsx - Project list: table/list view of all projects with columns (thumbnail, title, category, status, date, actions). Sortable by date/title. Status badges (published/draft). Edit and Delete action buttons per row. Bulk actions possible

Create packages/frontend/src/app/admin/projects/new/page.tsx - New project form: title (text input), description (textarea/rich text), category (select/dropdown), client name (text), project date (date picker), external URL (url input), technologies/tags (tag input - comma separated), status (published/draft radio). Image upload zone with drag-and-drop, preview thumbnails, ability to set primary image. Submit creates project via POST /api/projects

Create packages/frontend/src/app/admin/projects/[id]/edit/page.tsx - Edit project form: same as create but pre-populated with existing data. Fetches project on load. Existing images shown with delete option. Save updates via PUT /api/projects/:id

Create packages/frontend/src/components/admin/ImageUpload.tsx - Drag-and-drop image upload component: shows upload zone, accepts jpg/png/webp, shows upload progress, displays thumbnails of uploaded images, allows reordering (drag to reorder), delete button per image. Validates file type and size (max 5MB) client-side before upload

Create packages/frontend/src/components/admin/ProjectForm.tsx - Reusable form component used by both create and edit pages. Includes client-side validation (required fields: title, description, category), error display per field, loading state on submit
Create packages/frontend/src/components/admin/TagInput.tsx - Tag input component: type text + Enter to add tag, click X to remove, displays as colored pills

Create packages/frontend/src/lib/auth.ts - Auth utility: login function (POST /api/auth/login), stores JWT in httpOnly considerations or localStorage with token refresh awareness, logout function (clears token), getToken helper, isAuthenticated check
Create packages/frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts - Auth hook/context: provides current auth state, login/logout functions, wraps protected routes

Create packages/frontend/src/app/admin/projects/reorder/page.tsx - Project reorder page: drag-and-drop list of all projects to set display order, save order button sends PUT /api/projects/reorder with new order array
Implement delete confirmation modal before project deletion
Ensure admin panel works well on tablet (responsive sidebar collapses to hamburger)
acceptance_criteria: Admin login authenticates against backend and stores JWT
Unauthenticated users are redirected to login page
Project list displays all projects with correct status badges
Create project form submits successfully and new project appears in list
Edit project form loads existing data and saves changes
Image upload works via drag-and-drop with progress indication
File type validation rejects non-image files
Delete project shows confirmation and removes project
Project reorder saves new display order
Admin panel is responsive on tablet and desktop
Logout clears auth state and redirects to login
verification: Run npm run build from root and confirm frontend compiles without errors
Start both frontend and backend servers
Navigate to /admin/login, log in with seeded admin credentials
Create a new project with images, verify it appears in the project list and on the public portfolio
findings: Restructured app directory to use (site) route group for public pages (with Navigation/Footer) and separate /admin/ routes without the main site chrome. Build compiles all 11 routes successfully. Admin panel uses AdminShell wrapper component for auth protection rather than a (protected) route group layout.
